labour.loadingIncluded: Fully-loaded hourly cost INCLUDES: gross total pay (Sedlak OBW "wynagrodzenie całkowite" = base + bonuses / variable pay, indexed to 2026 and adjusted to the four clusters), paid annual leave and public holidays (inside the 12 monthly salaries), sick pay at 80% for 10 days, the statutory night allowance on one third of hours worked (3 × 8 h, shop-floor roles), and employer ZUS + FP + FGŚP + PPK (21.98%); divided by 1,720 productive hours.
labour.loadingNotIncluded: NOT included (not sourced): 13th-month salary (no statutory 13th month in Polish private industry — any annual bonus is already inside OBW total pay), shift allowances above the statutory night allowance, ZFŚS social fund write-off (mandatory at ≥50 FTE), bridging-pension FEP 1.5%, PFRON, meal / transport / work-clothing / medical exams, training time, overtime and weekend premiums, agency-worker margins, severance and jubilee-award accruals.
